message:
I once thought it was a little overboard when my neighbor, Martha, stockpiled enough bottled water to hydrate a small army. But when that unexpected winter storm hit and we were all scrambling for supplies, I found myself knocking on her door. 

Martha greeted me with a warm smile and a cooler full of ice and drinks, as if she were hosting a backyard barbecue instead of a snowpocalypse. Who knew that being gloriously over-prepared could turn into such a delightful community moment? 

So, while I might not need a mountain of water, I’ve started keeping a few extra essentials on hand for those ‘just in case’ days. 

What’s your favorite little prep tip that keeps you ready for anything?
